documents.name: Planning Commission Minutes - 2024-11-04
documents.synopsis: Official minutes of the November 4, 2024 Planning Commission meeting.
documents.description: PC approved site plan for 7422 Springfield Ave (residential addition, unanimous) and revised Stormwater Management Plan for Parkside at Warfield (unanimous). Town Updates included approval of 2025 meeting dates.

documents.name: County Updates
documents.synopsis: Carroll County planning update for December 2, 2024 Planning Commission meeting.
documents.description: County planning update provided for information purposes only.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report presenting upcoming Town projects: Sykesville Train Station renovation and South End Downtown Streetscape.
documents.description: Informational overview of two Town capital projects coming to the Planning Commission: (1) Sykesville Train Station interior/exterior alterations for a new restaurant (site plan and amended plat likely required); (2) South End Main Street streetscape improvements south of Oklahoma Avenue (hardscape, paving, bollards — no PC action anticipated). No formal action requested.

documents.name: Station Site Plans
documents.synopsis: Preliminary site plans for the Sykesville Train Station renovation project.
documents.description: Site plans showing proposed alterations to the Sykesville Train Station building in anticipation of a new restaurant tenant, including kitchen addition and ADA improvements.

documents.name: South End Streetscape Plans
documents.synopsis: Engineering plans for South End Downtown Streetscape improvements (Carroll County GRO-23-0006).
documents.description: 22-sheet engineering plan set by KCI Technologies for Main Street improvements in the southern Downtown area of Sykesville (Carroll County file GRO-23-0006). Covers grading, storm drain, site plan, signage, and streetscape details for the area south of Oklahoma Avenue including the train station parking lot reconfiguration.

documents.name: Agenda
documents.description: Agenda for the December 2, 2024 regular Planning Commission meeting covering approval of November 4 minutes, county update, and informational presentation on the Sykesville Train Station renovation and South End Downtown Streetscape projects.

documents.name: Planning Commission Minutes - 2024-12-02
documents.synopsis: Official minutes of the December 2, 2024 Planning Commission meeting.
documents.description: PC approved Nov 4 minutes unanimously. Business: Kevin Rubenstein and Joe Cosentini presented informational updates on the Train Station renovation and South End Streetscape projects (no action required). Town updates: Enclave at Parkside SWM plan submitted to county; Danny Mican introduced as PC candidate (to be appointed Dec 9); Springfield Ave paving deferred to spring. Adjourned 7:26 PM.
